**Verdict:** Direction HIT, magnitude MISS. The morning got the direction right but for the **wrong reason** — it leaned on macro/oil/CPI caution, whereas the actual driver was idiosyncratic mega-cap news (HD CEO medical leave + Tesla). The S2 breadth read (mega-cap concentration) was the most prescient element, as it correctly identified that XLY's fate hinges on 2-3 names.

- **Knowable at open?** **Partially.** The down bias was defensible at the open given active oil/Hormuz risk + CPI binary + credit delinquency stress. - **Key interaction:** The mega-cap concentration (S2) interacted with the idiosyncratic HD/Tesla news to produce a sector move far larger than the macro would justify. This is the "breadth failure / narrow leadership" dynamic the morning flagged — it cut the other way today (concentration amplified downside).
